caption: The drawing shows a single ornate black lace parasol angled diagonally, with the handle positioned toward the bottom left of the image and the canopy extending toward the upper right. The parasol canopy is composed of a sheer black fabric, decorated with small dotted patterns and a detailed black lace trim featuring floral motifs along the scalloped edge. The handle is a pale yellow color, straight and thin, ending in a decorative, round, carved knob at the bottom and a smaller ornamental finial at the top where the fabric connects. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with no other objects or details visible.
title: Parasol
